newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Ramayana revises up 1997 net forecast.
newsitem.headline: Ramayana revises up 1997 net forecast.

text.p: Indonesian retailer PT Ramayana Lestari Sentosa said on Wednesday it expected to post a net profit of 105 billion rupiah in 1997 against 82.4 billion rupiah in 1996.
Ramayana had in March revised up its 1997 net profit forecast to 90.2 billion rupiah from the previous forecast of 83.3 billion rupiah.
"The firm expects to post sales of 1.125 trillion rupiah. Net profit is expected at 105 billion rupiah," Ramayana said in a statement issued after a shareholders meeting on Wednesday.
Ramayana posted net sales of 865.60 billion rupiah in 1996.
Ramayana currently has 55 stores located mainly on Java island, the statement said.
The firm's target market would remain the middle to lower income brackets due to strong growth opportunities in the sector, Ramayana said. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
